blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The seat of government of this highly urbanized city is set to be relocated from the downtown to the uptown area to help ease urban congestion. According to Jann Guillmore Actub, spokesperson of the Office of the City Mayor, the construction of a “world-class government complex” in a 22.9-hectare area in Upper Carmen is meant to “trigger a new wave of economic growth.” For one, the new city hall will consolidate scattered local government offices into a one-stop hub, Actub said.
